capabilities: Pin folders as tabs rooted at the pinned folder
Open multiple independent Folder Pin explorer views
Remember expand state, scroll position, and selection per tab
Switch tab bar layouts (grid, vertical, horizontal)
Show an optional go-up button to jump to the parent folder
extras: Desktop only (uses Node APIs unavailable on mobile); requires Obsidian 1.6.2+; not yet available in the community plugin marketplace at the time of writing, with manual installation recommended during review; README is written in Chinese.
motivation: The author built it because managing several large projects in one vault made every switch require expanding, collapsing, and scrolling the file tree.
problem: Working on multiple large projects in one vault requires repeatedly expanding, collapsing, and scrolling the file tree to switch context.
summary: File explorer add-on that pins folders as tabs, giving each pinned folder its own focused view for quick project switching.
